info.description: Draws a circular arc from startAngle to endAngle around center (x, y).
params: x          → x coordinate of the center point
y          → y coordinate of the center point
startAngle → starting angle in degrees (0 = right)
endAngle   → ending angle in degrees
radius     → radius of the arc in pixels

info.description: Draws a filled rectangle using the current fill style and fill color. No border is drawn.
params: left   → x coordinate of the top-left corner
top    → y coordinate of the top-left corner
right  → x coordinate of the bottom-right corner
bottom → y coordinate of the bottom-right corner

info.signature: bar3d(left, top, right, bottom, depth, topflag)
info.description: Draws a 3D filled bar. Set topflag to 1 to draw the top face, 0 to skip it (useful for stacked bars).
params: left    → x coordinate of the top-left corner
top     → y coordinate of the top-left corner
right   → x coordinate of the bottom-right corner
bottom  → y coordinate of the bottom-right corner
depth   → depth of the 3D effect in pixels
topflag → 1 to draw the top face, 0 to skip

info.description: Draws a circle outline using the current drawing color. No fill is applied.
params: x      → x coordinate of the center
y      → y coordinate of the center
radius → radius of the circle in pixels

info.description: Draws a polygon outline using the current drawing color.
params: numpoints  → number of points (vertices) in the polygon
polypoints → array of x, y coordinate pairs — e.g. {x1,y1, x2,y2, ...}

info.signature: ellipse(x, y, startAngle, endAngle, xRadius, yRadius)
info.description: Draws an elliptical arc using the current drawing color.
params: x          → x coordinate of the center
y          → y coordinate of the center
startAngle → starting angle in degrees
endAngle   → ending angle in degrees
xRadius    → horizontal radius
yRadius    → vertical radius

info.description: Draws a filled ellipse using the current fill style and fill color.
params: x       → x coordinate of the center
y       → y coordinate of the center
xRadius → horizontal radius
yRadius → vertical radius

info.description: Draws and fills a polygon using the current fill style and color.
params: numpoints  → number of points (vertices) in the polygon
polypoints → array of x, y coordinate pairs — e.g. {x1,y1, x2,y2, ...}

info.description: Flood fills an enclosed area starting at (x, y), stopping when it hits the border color.
params: x      → x coordinate of a point inside the area to fill
y      → y coordinate of a point inside the area to fill
border → color value of the boundary line to stop at

info.description: Draws a straight line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2) using the current drawing color.
params: x1 → x coordinate of the start point
y1 → y coordinate of the start point
x2 → x coordinate of the end point
y2 → y coordinate of the end point

info.description: Draws a line from the current cursor position by a relative offset, then moves the cursor there.
params: dx → horizontal distance to move (can be negative)
dy → vertical distance to move (can be negative)

info.description: Draws a line from the current cursor position to (x, y) and moves the cursor there.
params: x → x coordinate of the destination
y → y coordinate of the destination

info.description: Moves the current cursor position by a relative offset without drawing anything.
params: dx → horizontal distance to move (can be negative)
dy → vertical distance to move (can be negative)

info.description: Moves the current cursor position to (x, y) without drawing anything.
params: x → x coordinate to move to
y → y coordinate to move to

info.description: Draws and fills a circular pie slice using the current fill style and color.
params: x          → x coordinate of the center
y          → y coordinate of the center
startAngle → starting angle in degrees
endAngle   → ending angle in degrees
radius     → radius of the pie slice

info.description: Draws a single pixel at (x, y) in the specified color.
params: x     → x coordinate of the pixel
y     → y coordinate of the pixel
color → color constant for the pixel (e.g. RED, WHITE)

info.description: Draws a rectangle outline using the current drawing color. No fill is applied.
params: left   → x coordinate of the top-left corner
top    → y coordinate of the top-left corner
right  → x coordinate of the bottom-right corner
bottom → y coordinate of the bottom-right corner

info.signature: sector(x, y, startAngle, endAngle, xRadius, yRadius)
info.description: Draws and fills an elliptical pie slice using the current fill style and color.
params: x          → x coordinate of the center
y          → y coordinate of the center
startAngle → starting angle in degrees
endAngle   → ending angle in degrees
xRadius    → horizontal radius
yRadius    → vertical radius

info.description: Captures a rectangular area of the screen into a memory buffer for later use with putimage.
params: left   → x coordinate of the top-left corner of the area
top    → y coordinate of the top-left corner of the area
right  → x coordinate of the bottom-right corner
bottom → y coordinate of the bottom-right corner
bitmap → pointer to a memory buffer to store the image

info.description: Returns the number of bytes needed to store a screen region. Use this to allocate memory before calling getimage.
params: left   → x coordinate of the top-left corner
top    → y coordinate of the top-left corner
right  → x coordinate of the bottom-right corner
bottom → y coordinate of the bottom-right corner

info.description: Places a previously captured image (from getimage) onto the screen at (left, top).
params: left   → x coordinate of the top-left placement position
top    → y coordinate of the top-left placement position
bitmap → pointer to the image buffer captured by getimage
op     → drawing operation constant (e.g. COPY_PUT, XOR_PUT)

info.description: Outputs a string at the current cursor position using the current font, size, and color.
params: text → the string to display (e.g. "Hello World")

info.description: Outputs a string at a specific (x, y) position using the current font, size, and color.
params: x    → x coordinate where the text starts
y    → y coordinate where the text starts
text → the string to display (e.g. "Hello World")

info.description: Sets how text is aligned relative to the (x, y) point given to outtextxy.
params: horiz → horizontal alignment (LEFT_TEXT, CENTER_TEXT, RIGHT_TEXT)
vert  → vertical alignment (BOTTOM_TEXT, CENTER_TEXT, TOP_TEXT)

info.description: Sets the font, direction, and size for all text output.
params: font      → font constant (e.g. DEFAULT_FONT, SANS_SERIF_FONT)
direction → HORIZ_DIR for left-to-right, VERT_DIR for bottom-to-top
charsize  → size multiplier — use a number like 1, 2, 3 (0 = user-defined)

info.description: Sets a custom character size ratio when charsize is 0 in settextstyle. Width = multx/divx, Height = multy/divy.
params: multx → width numerator
divx  → width denominator
multy → height numerator
divy  → height denominator

info.description: Returns the height in pixels of the given string using the current text settings.
params: text → the string to measure

info.description: Returns the width in pixels of the given string using the current text settings.
params: text → the string to measure

info.description: Sets the background color of the graphics window.
params: color → a color constant (e.g. BLACK, WHITE, BLUE)

info.description: Sets the current foreground drawing color for lines, shapes, and text.
params: color → a color constant (e.g. RED, GREEN, WHITE)

info.description: Sets a user-defined 8x8 fill pattern and the color to use when filling shapes.
params: upattern → pointer to an 8-byte array defining the custom fill pattern
color    → a color constant for the fill (e.g. RED, BLUE)

info.description: Sets the fill pattern and fill color used by bar, pieslice, fillellipse, and other filled shapes.
params: pattern → fill pattern constant (e.g. SOLID_FILL, HATCH_FILL, XHATCH_FILL)
color   → a color constant for the fill (e.g. RED, BLUE)

info.description: Changes one entry in the current color palette.
params: colornum → palette index to change (0–15)
color    → new color value to assign to that index

info.description: Sets all palette colors at once using a palettetype structure.
params: palette → pointer to a palettetype structure with the new color values

info.description: Sets a palette entry to a specific RGB color value (IBM 8514 driver only).
params: colornum → palette index to change
red      → red component (0–255)
green    → green component (0–255)
blue     → blue component (0–255)

info.description: Sets the style and thickness for lines drawn by line, rectangle, circle, etc.
params: linestyle  → line style constant (e.g. SOLID_LINE, DASHED_LINE, DOTTED_LINE)
upattern   → custom 16-bit pattern — only used when linestyle is USERBIT_LINE, otherwise pass 0
thickness  → NORM_WIDTH for normal, THICK_WIDTH for thick lines

info.description: Sets how lines are drawn onto the screen — normal copy or XOR mode.
params: mode → 0 for COPY_PUT (normal drawing), 1 for XOR_PUT (inverts existing pixels)

info.description: Fills an arccoordstype structure with the start and end points of the last arc drawn.
params: arccoords → pointer to an arccoordstype struct to store the result

info.description: Returns the aspect ratio of the current graphics mode. Use this to draw true circles.
params: xasp → pointer to an int — receives the horizontal aspect value
yasp → pointer to an int — receives the vertical aspect value

info.description: Returns the current background color as an integer.
Returns the current foreground drawing color as an integer.
Returns a pointer to the default palette for the current graphics driver.
Returns the name of the current graphics driver as a string (e.g. "EGA/VGA").
Copies the current user-defined fill pattern into the given 8-byte buffer.
params: pattern → pointer to an 8-byte char array to receive the fill pattern

info.description: Fills a fillsettingstype struct with the current fill pattern and fill color.
params: fillinfo → pointer to a fillsettingstype struct to store the result

info.description: Returns the current graphics mode as an integer.
Fills a linesettingstype struct with the current line style, pattern, and thickness.
params: lineinfo → pointer to a linesettingstype struct to store the result

info.description: Returns the highest valid color number in the current graphics mode (usually 15).
Returns the highest graphics mode number available for the current driver.
Returns the maximum x coordinate (screen width minus 1) for the current graphics mode.
Returns the maximum y coordinate (screen height minus 1) for the current graphics mode.
Returns the name of a graphics mode as a string (e.g. "640 x 480 VGA").
params: modenumber → the mode number to look up

info.description: Returns the lowest and highest valid mode numbers for the given graphics driver.
params: graphdriver → the graphics driver number to query
lomode      → pointer to an int — receives the lowest mode number
himode      → pointer to an int — receives the highest mode number

info.description: Fills a palettetype struct with the current palette colors.
params: palette → pointer to a palettetype struct to store the result

info.description: Returns the number of entries in the current color palette.
Returns the color of the pixel at (x, y) as an integer.
params: x → x coordinate of the pixel
y → y coordinate of the pixel

info.description: Fills a textsettingstype struct with the current font, direction, size, and justification settings.
params: texttypeinfo → pointer to a textsettingstype struct to store the result

info.description: Fills a viewporttype struct with the current viewport boundaries and clip flag.
params: viewport → pointer to a viewporttype struct to store the result

info.description: Returns the x coordinate of the current cursor position.
Returns the y coordinate of the current cursor position.
Clears the entire graphics screen and moves the cursor back to (0, 0).
Clears only the current viewport area and moves the cursor to (0, 0) within it.
Shuts down the graphics system and restores the screen to its original text mode.
Detects the best graphics driver and mode for your hardware without initializing graphics.
params: graphdriver → pointer to an int — receives the detected driver number
graphmode   → pointer to an int — receives the recommended mode number

info.description: Resets all graphics settings to their defaults — color, fill style, line style, viewport, and text style.
Returns a human-readable error message string for a given graphics error code.
params: errorcode → an error code — usually the result of calling graphresult()

info.description: Returns the error code for the last graphics operation. Returns 0 (grOk) if everything is fine.
Initializes the graphics system. Pass DETECT as the driver to auto-detect your graphics card. Always call this before any drawing.
params: graphdriver  → pointer to an int — pass the address of a variable set to DETECT for auto-detection
graphmode    → pointer to an int — receives the selected mode (or set to 0 with DETECT)
pathtodriver → path to the folder containing .BGI driver files — use "" for the current folder

info.description: Loads a stroked font from a .CHR file and returns a font number you can use with settextstyle.
params: name → path to the .CHR font file (e.g. "myfont.chr")

info.description: Installs a user-supplied graphics driver and returns a driver number.
params: name   → name of the driver to install
detect → pointer to a detection function, or NULL to skip auto-detection

info.description: Temporarily restores the screen to text mode without closing the graphics system. Call setgraphmode to return.
Sets which video page drawing commands write to (for double-buffered animation).
params: page → page number to draw to (0-based)

info.description: Overrides the default aspect ratio. Used to correct distortion on some monitors.
params: xasp → horizontal aspect value
yasp → vertical aspect value

info.description: Sets the size of the internal scan buffer used by floodfill and fillpoly. Call before initgraph.
params: bufsize → buffer size in bytes (default is 4096)

info.description: Switches to a specific graphics mode and clears the screen. Also used to return from restorecrtmode.
params: mode → a valid graphics mode number for the current driver

info.description: Defines a rectangular viewport as the active drawing area. All coordinates become relative to it.
params: left   → x coordinate of the top-left corner
top    → y coordinate of the top-left corner
right  → x coordinate of the bottom-right corner
bottom → y coordinate of the bottom-right corner
clip   → 1 to clip drawing at the viewport edges, 0 to allow drawing outside

info.description: Sets which video page is displayed on screen (for double-buffered animation).
params: page → page number to display (0-based)
